offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures less-lethal launchers, projectiles and pepper sprays for consumers, law enforcement agencies and private security firms. It sells through its website, branded stores, retail dealers and direct agency sales.

primary_products.value: CO₂-powered launchers; kinetic and irritant projectiles; pepper sprays; launcher accessories

primary_services.value: Launcher training and instructor certification for law enforcement and security personnel

customer_segment.value: B2C: Individuals buying personal and home defense equipment; B2G: Law enforcement and corrections agencies; B2B: Private security firms and sporting goods retailers

end_markets.value: Consumer personal safety; law enforcement; private security; corrections

revenue_model.value: product sales: Launchers, replacement projectiles, pepper sprays and accessories

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Turns components and materials into launchers and consumables for consumers, retailers and agencies; retailer: Sells its finished products directly to consumers through its website and stores

geography_served.value: global: Primarily the United States, with operations in South Africa and sales in other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: Less-lethal launchers, projectiles, pepper sprays and accessories share personal safety and security customers

distribution_channels.value: online: Company e-commerce site and third-party online marketplaces; third-party retail: Sporting goods and outdoor retailers; distributors / dealers: Independent equipment dealers and international distributors; own locations: Company-operated stores and showrooms; direct sales: Agency sales to law enforcement and private security organizations
distribution_channels.category: online; third-party retail; distributors / dealers; own locations; direct sales

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: State and local restrictions on launcher and irritant sales, plus export controls on covered products

notes: Whether agency training generates separate fees is unclear.
